defects.description: Addresses idempotency / exactly-once-effect handling to prevent double-fulfillment under retries.
Addresses backpressure/autoscaling for the bursty 50x load spike rather than assuming fixed capacity.
Addresses retry/dead-letter handling so a transient fulfillment failure does not lose the order.
Separates the fast "acknowledge/show processing" path from the slower fulfillment path to meet the 5-second visibility requirement without blocking on the slow step.
Addresses per-order ordering guarantees explicitly (either ensures ordering per order/customer, or explicitly argues it is not required).
Addresses observability/monitoring of queue depth, processing lag, or failure rate as part of the design, not an afterthought.
